tokens.VOICE_DOUBLES_HOOK: Skip the chemistry quiz — one round of wall balls tells you if it's a match.
tokens.VOICE_NEWS_TAKE: Everyone trains the sled because it's scary and obvious. Wall balls win or lose the back half — boring reps now, free minutes later.

news.title: Season kickoff: what I'm changing this year
news.summary: New season means new structure — heavier sled work, longer threshold runs, less junk volume.
news.take: Last year I trained tired. This year I train on purpose — if a session doesn't move a number, it's out.

news.title: Doubles is the fastest-growing division
news.summary: Pairs entries are up again this season — and the standards are rising with them.
news.take: 59:40 isn't bragging, it's homework — Sam and I logged every split to get there. Find your person early.

news.title: Race-day fuelling, minus the influencer nonsense
news.summary: What actually works on race morning: carbs early, nothing new, and a plan for the last four stations.
news.take: If your fuelling plan needs a spreadsheet tab and a prayer, it's not a plan. Boring food, boring wins.
